title: Recursive Environment Scaling for General Long-Horizon Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.16397v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study environment scaling as a way to increase agent-benchmark difficulty while holding core task objectives fixed. Our framework, Recursive Environment Scaling (RES), transforms existing benchmark environments while preserving their objectives and completion requirements. A proposer changes information access, resource relations, and execution dependencies; execution-grounded checks validate the resulting candidate, and accepted changes are inherited across rounds. This produces related environments for paired evaluation and training-trajectory collection. Experiments on 294 initial tasks from three benchmarks show lower task success for all six evaluation models, with decreases of 57.14--77.14 percentage points on Claw-Eval-Live. With equal trajectory counts and identical optimization settings, fine-tuning on RES trajectories outperforms original-trajectory SFT in all nine model--benchmark comparisons by 7.00--14.61 percentage point

translated_title: 面向通用长时程智能体的递归环境扩展
translated_abstract: 我们研究环境扩展作为一种在保持核心任务目标不变的情况下提升智能体基准测试难度的方法。我们的框架——递归环境扩展（RES）——在保留原有目标与完成要求的前提下对现有基准环境进行转换。一个提议者会改变信息访问方式、资源关系和执行依赖关系；基于执行的检查验证所生成的候选环境，被接受的更改在各轮之间继承。这一过程产出一系列相关环境，可用于配对评估和训练轨迹收集。在来自三个基准的294个初始任务上的实验表明，全部六个评估模型的任务成功率均出现下降，在Claw-Eval-Live上降幅达57.14至77.14个百分点。在轨迹数量相同、优化设置一致的条件下，基于RES轨迹的微调在全部九个模型-基准对比中均优于原始轨迹SFT，领先幅度为7.00至14.61个百分点。
tldr: 该论文提出递归环境扩展（RES）框架，在保留任务目标的前提下递归改造基准环境以提升评测难度，使六个模型成功率大幅下降，并利用生成的轨迹微调模型，在全部九组对比中比原始轨迹SFT高出7.00至14.61个百分点。
